name: qaq
description: Launch resilience guard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): supervises dsh web, reads the real DOM via headless Chrome + CDP to catch host crashes / UI red-screens / plugin degradation, and auto-rolls-back to the last known-good config. Non-invasive, one-command setup, structured logs, plugin hot-update protection.
author: WTStarMark

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --banner:js="import { createRequire as __qaqCRequire } from 'module'; const require = __qaqCRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/qaq.mjs && pnpm run build:plugin
